en: A black‑and‑white historic street view showing an elegant, broad, tree‑lined avenue flanked by ornate late‑19th‑century residential buildings. The left side features tall brick townhouses with decorative facades and wrought‑iron balconies; the right side shows similarly elaborate villas and apartment houses with turrets and gables. Children stand and play in the cobbled street, while a woman pushes a large old‑fashioned baby carriage on the right. Gas street lamps line the sidewalks. The scene has a calm, bourgeois urban atmosphere and appears to be taken slightly uphill toward a cluster of turreted buildings in the distance. There is no visible postcard title or caption, only faint signage on a wall that is not clearly legible.
